scenario: A bakery produces exactly six batches — Almond, Brioche, Croissant, Danish, Éclair, and Frangipane — one per time slot in six consecutive slots numbered 1 through 6. Each batch is produced in exactly one of two ovens: the deck oven or the convection oven. The following conditions apply:

rules.description: Almond is produced in an earlier slot than Danish.
Croissant is produced in an earlier slot than Éclair.
Brioche and Frangipane are not produced in adjacent slots.
Almond and Croissant are both produced in the deck oven.
Danish and Éclair are produced in different ovens.
If Brioche is in slot 1, then Frangipane is produced in the deck oven.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be an acceptable assignment of batches to slots and ovens, listed in slot order from 1 to 6?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Slot 1: Danish/deck; Slot 2: Almond/deck; Slot 3: Croissant/deck; Slot 4: Éclair/deck; Slot 5: Brioche/convection; Slot 6: Frangipane/convection

choices.label: B
choices.text: Slot 1: Croissant/deck; Slot 2: Almond/deck; Slot 3: Brioche/convection; Slot 4: Danish/convection; Slot 5: Frangipane/convection; Slot 6: Éclair/deck

choices.label: C
choices.text: Slot 1: Almond/deck; Slot 2: Brioche/convection; Slot 3: Croissant/deck; Slot 4: Éclair/deck; Slot 5: Danish/convection; Slot 6: Frangipane/convection

choices.label: D
choices.text: Slot 1: Almond/deck; Slot 2: Croissant/convection; Slot 3: Brioche/deck; Slot 4: Frangipane/convection; Slot 5: Danish/convection; Slot 6: Éclair/deck

choices.label: E
choices.text: Slot 1: Brioche/deck; Slot 2: Almond/deck; Slot 3: Frangipane/convection; Slot 4: Croissant/deck; Slot 5: Éclair/deck; Slot 6: Danish/convection

explanations.correct: Choice C satisfies every constraint: Almond (slot 1) before Danish (slot 5) ✓; Croissant (slot 3) before Éclair (slot 4) ✓; Brioche (slot 2) and Frangipane (slot 6) are not adjacent ✓; Almond and Croissant are both in the deck oven ✓; Danish (convection) and Éclair (deck) are in different ovens ✓; Brioche is not in slot 1, so the conditional does not apply ✓.
explanations.A: Violates the rule that Almond must come before Danish — Danish is in slot 1 while Almond is in slot 2.
explanations.B: Danish (slot 4) and Éclair (slot 6) must be in different ovens, but both are assigned to the deck oven here (Éclair deck, Danish convection — actually Danish/convection and Éclair/deck differ, BUT Croissant is assigned convection, violating the rule that Croissant must be in the deck oven).
explanations.D: Croissant is assigned to the convection oven, violating the rule that Croissant must be produced in the deck oven.
explanations.E: Croissant (slot 4) comes after Éclair (slot 5)? No — Éclair is slot 5 and Croissant is slot 4, so Croissant before Éclair is satisfied. However, Danish is in slot 6 with convection oven and Éclair in slot 5 with deck oven — those differ ✓. The actual violation: Brioche is in slot 1, triggering the conditional that Frangipane must be in the deck oven, but Frangipane is assigned convection.
